learning_outcomes.text: Know the different legal forms of companies.
Can evaluate advantages and disadvantages of different legal forms and select the correct legal form for their own ideas.
Know the necessary steps and procedures for founding a start-up.
Can create and evaluate a business plan for a start-up.
Recognize the necessity of cost management and cost control in an international environment.
Understand the tasks and structure of internal company accounting.
Can calculate product costs and understand the various influencing factors on the total costs of a product.
Recognize their own contribution in product development to product costs and life cycle costs.
Recognize influencing factors on product costs as well as methods for cost reduction.
Understand the necessities and challenges of investments and can calculate the profitability of investments.

syllabus_topics: Legal forms of companies in Germany
Steps for founding a company in different legal forms
Buyer and seller motivation, importance of customer value and customer orientation
Tasks and implementation of internal accounting, cost type, cost center, and cost object accounting
Responsibility and influence of product development on product and life cycle costs
Methods of cost control in product development
Methods of cost reduction in product development
